mechanism_summary: Pre-register BTCUSD-equivalent volatility-adaptive Supertrend screening before WFA execution.
instrument_scope: BTCUSD-equivalent 1h crypto CFD hypothesis using Binance BTCUSDT proxy research data; FTMO/MT5-listed by terminal universe evidence, research-only until MT5 data equivalence is proven.
expected_trade_frequency: Medium frequency; no low-frequency exception is registered and the default 200-trade floor applies.
data_sources: FTMO terminal universe snapshot lists BTCUSD, but MT5 data equivalence is not assumed.
cost_assumptions: Use only vol_adaptive_trend WFA config costs: fees 0.0006 and slippage 0.0002, no hidden overrides.

wfa_design.window_policy: Use the canonical 3m training / 1m testing / 1m step WFA scheme encoded in the Phase 8D runtime-feasibility config.
wfa_design.optimizer_policy: Use the preregistered 25-trial runtime-feasibility route and count this attempt in the denominator.
wfa_design.repair_rationale: Pre-result mechanical runtime-feasibility repair: the canonical VOL_ADAPTIVE_TREND route uses 150 trials on BTC H1, and the immediately prior BTC H1 Phase 8D 150-trial screening route timed out after 1800000ms before accepted WFA outputs. This attempt preserves the hypothesis, strategy source, parameter space, data source, and costs but uses a Phase 8D-specific 25-trial config before any performance result is known.

invalidation_criteria: Reject as non-survivor if real WFA fails any Phase 8D survivor floor on completed OOS windows, total trades, return proxy, or positive OOS window ratio.
Reject any deployment or Phase 8E implication unless a separate survivor exists with MT5 instrument equivalence and explicit operator authorization.
Treat any post-result change to symbol, timeframe, cost, parameter space, data source, or WFA config as a new denominator-tracked attempt.
